interactions.summary: Jiang asks why God would choose such a forgetful messenger, a student answers that each person must use free will to make the journey individually, and Jiang accepts that answer as the right direction.
interactions.speaker_attribution: Jiang question with student answer and Jiang confirmation

interactions.summary: A student says Dante helps by writing the book, and Jiang treats that answer as the decisive reason the whole heavenly trip had to happen.
A student begins to answer that humans have a concept of space and time, but Jiang keeps pressing toward the more exact account of how Dante could actually write the poem.
interactions.speaker_attribution: Student partial answer with Jiang interruption

speaker_notes.note: The isolated "Okay" is likely Jiang acknowledging the previous student answer before moving into his next question.

claims.claim: Jiang restates the pedagogical puzzle as a question about why God would rely on a messenger who forgets most of what he was taught.
A student answers that God wants human beings to use free will to choose nearness to him individually, so Dante cannot take the trip on anyone else's behalf.
Jiang agrees with the free-will answer and asks how Dante can help other people undertake that same journey themselves.
A student answers that Dante helps by writing the book.
Jiang says that the necessity of writing the Divine Comedy is the reason the heavenly journey had to happen in the first place.
A student's incomplete answer suggests that human access to space and time may be part of what lets Dante write what God cannot.

signature_moments.moment: The student's answer makes free will the reason Dante cannot save the reader by proxy.
signature_moments.source_phrase: Dante can't take that trip for us
signature_moments.why_it_matters: It turns the whole lecture from a one-man revelation into a model in which every reader must reenact the ascent personally.

signature_moments.moment: The reason Dante goes to heaven is not to stay there but to write the book.
signature_moments.source_phrase: By writing this book... This is why this had to happen
signature_moments.why_it_matters: It finally answers Jiang's Ezekiel puzzle by tying heavenly experience to a human artifact that others can use.

glossary_terms.definition_or_usage: The student's explanation for why each person must choose the ascent personally and why Dante cannot complete the journey on behalf of others.

chronology_notes.note: This 2026-06-16 packet resolves the forgetful-prophet puzzle by shifting from transmission to participation: Dante's function is to write a form that lets later readers make the trip themselves.

uncertainty_notes.note: The student's space-and-time answer is cut off before it becomes a full model, so it should be treated as a partial intuition rather than a finished claim.
